local_articles.title: Cameron Young shares 2nd-round lead at Rocket Classic after shooting 9-under 61
local_articles.snippet: Cameron Young birdied seven of his first eight holes in the second round of the Rocket Classic and thought he had a shot at the lowest score in PGA Tour history. "I was thinking 55," he said. Young cooled off with two birdies on his back nine in a bogey-free round, closing with a Detroit Golf Club-record tying 61 to reach 10 under for the tournament to tie Patrick Cantlay (66) and Patrick Fishburn (66) atop the leaderboard Friday. "You hate to call it a disappointing 61," he said, lamenting missing many birdie opportunities that prevented him from breaking Jim Furyk's record 58 that has stood for a decade. Young, the No. 3 player in the world with three wins this season, shot a 59 in 2024 at the Travelers Championship and had a chance to join Furyk with multiple sub-60 rounds on the PGA Tour. local_articles.title: SpaceX rocket to hit the Moon? Date, impact details and why experts are tracking it
local_articles.snippet: The rocket’s upper stage, which helped launch two lunar landers more than a year ago, is expected to hit the Moon on Wednesday, according to a report by the Associated Press. The collision was not intentional, but experts say the event could provide valuable data on how objects behave when they strike the lunar surface. The impact is expected to take place near Einstein Crater on the Moon’s sunlit western limb. Observers in eastern parts of the US and Canada, along with parts of South America, are expected to have the best chance of monitoring the aftermath because of the timing of the event. local_articles.title: Pegula sets up Washington Open final against Eala
local_articles.snippet: Aug 1 - Top-seeded American Jessica Pegula beat Russia's Diana Shnaider 7-5 6-4 on Saturday and set up a Washington Open final against the Philippines' Alexandra Eala, who defeated Japan's Naomi Osaka 6-4 6-2. World number three Pegula is seeking her third title of the year and 12th of her career after winning in Dubai and Charleston. The 32-year-old won her first WTA title in Washington in 2019. The 22-year-old Shnaider, who reached this year's French Open semi-finals, was bidding for her sixth WTA title. She raced into a 5-2 lead in the opening set, but Pegula began her comeback by holding serve before breaking in the ninth game. The American then held to love to level the set at 5-5, broke again in the next game and served out the set when Shnaider sent a forehand wide. questions.title: Which international organization, if any, will first gain direct access to Aung San Suu Kyi in detention during 2026?
questions.background: Aung San Suu Kyi has been detained since Myanmar's military overthrew her government in February 2021. Her access to outside visitors has been tightly restricted.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements from the visiting organization or Myanmar authorities, corroborated by established news reporting. Qualifying Event : Direct access means a completed in-person meeting with Suu Kyi by a representative acting on behalf of an international organization. Permission or an announced plan without a completed visit does not qualify. Resolution : Resolve to the first international organization publicly confirmed to have completed such a visit during 2026. If no qualifying visit is confirmed by December 31, 2026, resolve that no organization qualified. Accepted Answer Format : The organization's name, or a statement that no organization qualified.
